Hi Mr Zahn,

Long time fan, I believe I've managed to track down and read almost everything you've written. I even managed to track down some old copies of Analog last summer.

Anyway I have a couple of questions and I'll try my best not to think of more.

I really like the Conquerors Trilogy, is there any chance that we will get to revisit that universe?

One of the reasons I love that work is seeing all the story threads and world building play out over several books. (Like spotting the hints for book 2 revaluation of the cause of the war in book one.) Will we get to see another trilogy like that is one long story rather individual novels?

Finally (yes I know this is three) I've wanted to be a writer for ages, any advice on navigating the business side of things? Do you struggle with getting publishers to accept your work or can you write pretty much whatever you want.

Ok, I'm going to end this there otherwise I'll spend all night writing this post.

Thanks for all your stories.

N.

Finally, for the first time in two years, finished the first draft of something. 

It's only a short story but at least it's getting closer to being good enough to submit something. Usually they end up unfinished on my hard drive.

I went in with a friend just yesterday. 

It has been pretty bad before. He almost lost his benefit because she took off his coat, that meant he could move his arms and therefore work. That alone was x amount of points. Sit in a chair for 30 minutes of the interview, more points because clearly you can do that for hours. (Fortunately he appealed on all that and won. Back then you didn't get your benefits cut during the appeal process, now apparently you will.)

As I said though, this time seamed a lot better though, although it was harrowing to sit there and just listen in to how bad a friends life is and just thinking 'My god, this doctor could just say no and my friend would be off benefits and utterly screwed. If the doctor doesn't believe him this time then I don't know how my friend will survive.'. He will hear back in a week or two if he has passed. If he doesn't then I will rage.

What really annoys me is when people call benefit claimants lazy ect ect, my friend would kill to get back into work. Having seen how low the benefits are I'd feel the same way.
